verified.value: Merged. The lane verified the leaderboard endpoint (GET stats-data.hyperliquid.xyz/Mainnet/leaderboard: leaderboardRows with ethAddress, accountValue, windowPerformances; 716 accounts at month-PnL rank with account value >= $1M; top 200 used) and clearinghouseState (about 0.3 s per call). Merger change: the unit's IPAddressAllow=any / IPAddressDeny=localhost ... lines dropped - allow-any made the deny list a no-op, and a deny on localhost would break DNS through systemd-resolved if allow were ever narrowed; the .timer file is not installed (the service already loops every 15 minutes). install.sh installs and starts the service.

title: 东京主机每 15 分钟记录 HL 头部账户的持仓(聪明钱快照)
source: Jazz 10-19「跟踪 smart money」;HL 链上全透明 —— 任何地址的持仓都能用 info 接口 clearinghouseState 查

acceptance.check: 新模块 src/exec_host/whales.py:① 名单 —— 先验证 GET https://stats-data.hyperliquid.xyz/Mainnet/leaderboard 是否返回排行(字段、大小、是否需要分页),能用就每天取一次:按 30 天 PnL 取前 200、账户净值 ≥ 100 万美元;不能用就读 /var/lib/cometcloud/whales_addresses.txt(一行一个地址)并在报告里写明;② 每 15 分钟对名单逐个 POST info {type: clearinghouseState, user} → 记 (ts, address, coin, szi, entryPx, positionValue, unrealizedPnl, leverage, marginUsed, accountValue),追加到 /var/lib/cometcloud/rec/whales/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz;按 HL 的权重限速节流(每轮 ≤ 200 次请求,失败重试 2 次,整轮失败写日志不崩)。不读私钥、不写 Supabase。systemd service + timer(OnCalendar 每 15 分钟,User=cometcloud,加固同执行器)。测试用假响应:名单筛选、记录字段、限速节流、单个地址失败不影响整轮。
acceptance.expect: tests/test_exec_host_whales.py 全绿;卡 notes 写 leaderboard 端点的实测结论;in_review,推 lane-b/T-130。install.sh 由 Seth 合并时接(别改它)。

prior_value: 几周之后能量:头部账户净持仓的变化是否领先价格、领先多久 —— 我们没找到同行评审的证据(跟单 / 排行榜的持续性只有平台自述),所以只能自己录、自己量。
